title: AT-RL: Support Allied Telesis Resiliency Link
description:
Adding dissector support for Allied Telesis Resiliency Link frames.

These frames are used by virtual chassis stacks (VCS) to signal active master availability.\
Split-brain scenario detection and response can be accomplished by using resiliency links.
